scope.zh: 财报日期来自站内财报刷新台账（每周一伦敦时间09:00更新），其余为会议、电网与基准节点，每条带来源与证据级别。
scope.en: Earnings dates come from the site’s earnings-refresh ledger (updated Mondays 09:00 London); the rest are conference, grid and benchmark milestones, each with a source and evidence level.

primary-read.zh: 已打开并阅读官方原文。
primary-read.en: Official primary document opened and read.

primary-located.zh: 已定位官方来源，细节取自搜索摘要，未逐字核对。
primary-located.en: Official source located; details come from search summaries, not checked verbatim.

secondary-authoritative.zh: 权威机构或行业组织的二手转述。
secondary-authoritative.en: Relayed by an authoritative body or trade press.

secondary.zh: 媒体或聚合站摘要，数字可能因口径或时点不同而冲突。
secondary.en: Press or aggregator summary; figures may conflict by scope or timing.

editorial.zh: 本站对财报问答与来源的编辑归纳，不是已核实结论。
editorial.en: This site’s editorial synthesis of Q&A and sources; not a verified conclusion.

note.zh: 报道称已售罄；2027年起移至旧金山 Moscone。
note.en: Reported sold out; moves to San Francisco Moscone from 2027.

note.zh: 日期来自 NVIDIA 会话目录页标题（“GTC Berlin 10月20–22日”），年份按 gtc26 目录推断为2026；请到官网确认。
note.en: Dates come from the title of an NVIDIA session-catalog page (“GTC Berlin Oct 20–22”); the year is inferred as 2026 from the gtc26 catalog. Confirm on NVIDIA’s site.

note.zh: 报道称12月举行，具体日期未核实。
note.en: Reported for December; the exact date was not verified.

title.en: UBS Global Technology and AI Conference (Ceva event listing)

note.en: Ceva lists November 30 at the Phoenician Hotel, Scottsdale; this is not a verified full conference span. Speaker, time and public webcast pending. Research question: how do AI IP licenses translate into infrastructure design wins and revenue?

note.zh: 历史场次：10:10 AM PT；公司IR列有 webcast 链接，未核实回放可用性。研究问题：AI服务器需求、液冷交付与毛利率相较上次财报有何变化？
note.en: Historical session: 10:10 AM PT. Company IR lists a webcast link; replay availability not verified. Research question: what changed in AI server demand, liquid-cooling delivery and margins since earnings?
